properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities: what realizes this is documentation — the README, the getting-started material, the diagrams — and none of it is written yet. It arrives with BL-102, at which point those documents should be registered as artifacts like any other deliverable, since a doc that drifts from the design is the same defect as code that does.
